feature: Lab routing markers ('LLIS', '#LC', ...) removed from analyte names - generic, frequency-based
test_type: .NET console probe (/tmp/sanprobe) against the real LabMarkerSanitizer + full solution build
build: dotnet build MedicalApp.csproj => Build succeeded, 0 Warning(s), 0 Error(s)
mechanism: A leading token of 2-6 uppercase letters (optionally prefixed with # or *) is removed ONLY when it opens >= 3 DISTINCT parameters of the same report; the remainder must be >= 3 chars and contain a lowercase letter. A small allow-list (LDL, HDL, AC, IgG, TSH, INR, VSH, CA, PSA, ...) is never removed whatever the frequency. Also cleans parameter_normalized_en (so the LOINC matcher gets clean names) and renames abnormal_findings in sync.
checks: User's real case: 'LLIS Amilaza serica' / 'LLIS Trigliceride' -> clean names, 4 parameters cleaned, untouched analyte preserved
parameter_normalized_en cleaned as well (LOINC matcher receives 'Amylase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma')
abnormal_findings renamed in sync with key_results
ANTI-REGRESSION: 'LDL colesterol' x3, 'AC anti-HBs/HCV/HIV', 'IgG/IgA/IgM seric' untouched
Frequency threshold respected: a token seen only twice is NOT removed
All-caps remainder never stripped ('ABC TSH REFLEX' untouched)
Single-word parameters, null result and empty key_results are safe
7+ letter tokens ('HEMATOLOGIE Leucocite') are not treated as margin codes
Idempotent: a second pass changes nothing
wiring: InterpretationController (B2C): runs after Gemini, BEFORE StatusValidator and the LOINC matcher; try/catch so it can never break the flow
CamBatchService (B2B/CAM): same position, before the LOINC matcher
GeminiMedicalInterpretationService: new generic prompt rule 'LAB ROUTING CODES ARE NOT PART OF THE NAME' (layer 1 prevention)
scope_decision_by_user: Applied to NEW interpretations only (B2C + CAM). Already archived interpretations keep 'LLIS Amilaza serica'.
